Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At Groomers, INC., accessible from groomersincmiami.com, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Groomers, INC. and how we use it internally.
Privacy.collectDesc: The personal information that you are asked to provide (such as name, email, phone, and pet photos), and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask for it. We do not share your data with third parties.
Privacy.useItem1: Provide, operate, and maintain our website
Privacy.useItem2: Improve, personalize, and expand our service offering
Privacy.useItem3: Understand and analyze how you use our website to improve your experience
Privacy.useItem4: Communicate with you directly to manage your appointments and provide support
Privacy.contactDesc: If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us through our contact section.
